summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that sets up an Apache web server service. It builds an image from the current directory, exposes ports 80 and 443 for HTTP and HTTPS traffic, and mounts a local source directory into the container so Apache serves files from there.

explanations.6: The double percent signs around 'port=80' suggest this is a template variable that gets replaced with an actual port number at runtime—in this case, defaulting to 80 if not overridden.
